# Coalesce

Gives the first element of an array that is not null.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
Coalesce(values)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `values` | array | The array to search, from its first element to its last. Null is read as the empty array. Any other value that is not an array is a runtime error. |

## Returns

Any. The first element that is not null, as it is. Null when the array is empty or every element in it is null.

## Example

`Coalesce([null, "", "x"])` returns `""`.

`Coalesce([null, null])` returns null.
